Embedding model fixed: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (local, not swappable via env vars). The bundled evaluate.py separately hardcodes GPT-4o-mini as its own LLM-as-Judge model.
gpt_4_1_substitution: EASY -- REPO_QA_MODEL_NAME is already a plain config value, no code change needed for the pipeline itself. The evaluator's own hardcoded GPT-4o-mini judge would need a small code edit if consistency with the pipeline's own model is desired.
porting_effort_to_sweqa_pro_or_repoprobe: EASY-MODERATE per the corrected audit: clone_repo() already accepts an arbitrary GitHub URL (not a hardcoded target); main.py/main_multi_agent.py read question records from a hardcoded input_path in HiFiRepoQA's own JSON schema (repo/title/body/url/language) with no CLI args. Porting requires: (1) an adapter script converting SWE-QA-Pro/RepoProbe question records into this JSON schema, (2) editing/wrapping the hardcoded input_path/output_dir string literals. No core DAG/agent logic changes needed. Tree-sitter already covers the relevant languages.
